QuestInfo.name: A Proper Introduction
QuestInfo.0: The time has finally come. I hope you're all ready.
QuestInfo.1: All preparations are complete! As #p1402000# said, every hero has to take their first step. Head into #m130000000#. #bYou will only have to make it past the guards in the Knights Chamber.#k.
QuestInfo.2: The plan was a complete success! An entrance worthy of the world's greatest thief!

1.0: That was the kind of intro a real hero needs. My name will be on every breath from here to Mu Lung.

yes.0: New Maple World, get ready to meet the greatest thief of all time!

default.0: The guards are on high alert for any trespassers, so you will have to be quite sparing in your approach. But I'm sure you will be just fine.
